residual_risks: The integral Hilbert–Chow CH0 isomorphism may be implicit in older literature under birational/universal CH0-trivial morphism terminology.

value.rationale: Settles an explicitly conjectured integral characteristic-class identity in every symmetric order for the broad, nontrivial class of irregularity-zero surfaces (including K3 and positive-geometric-genus general-type surfaces). Integral resolution of CH0 is a motivated structural tool beyond numerical Euler characteristic.
